answer: Rather than counting accounts, the registry prices them: an identity persists only while its holder escrows a bond on a narrow ledge above a slashing line, releasable against hardware attestation. Clones pay the fee honest agents amortize across real work, and the protocol lifts it along a cost ridge when enrollment outpaces settled output. A tide of coordinated signups costs more with each added puppet, so the attack loses money as it spreads.
